_comment: Registry of the numeric constants the RBMK model rests on, with their source. Mission rule 2: nothing is guessed. status is one of: verified (cites a source), to_verify (a reference value not yet confirmed against a primary/NIKIET source), placeholder (a value with no source at all). A placeholder is allowed only when it is a FALLBACK that is not used while real data is present. The build gate warns on to_verify and FAILS on any non-fallback placeholder.

delayed.beta_eff.source: RBMK literature (value commonly quoted); to confirm against a NIKIET/design document

delayed.generation_time.source: RBMK literature (prompt generation time ~0.7 ms); to confirm

delayed.lambda_i.source: Keepin six-group set (Western evaluation). The RBMK used its own six-group set — replace from a NIKIET/ABBN source.

delayed.beta_fractions.source: Keepin six-group set (Western evaluation). RBMK-specific set to be sourced.

feedback.void_coeff.source: RBMK reference value (strongly positive at operating burnup); to confirm against NIKIET data

xenon.coeff.source: Reference value; to confirm against a NIKIET/design source

rodworth.scale.source: Reference worth used to scale the perturbation sum; to replace with a measured/design rod-worth curve

xsec.void_feedback_scale.source: Hand-set scale used only by the legacy fallback cell when the derived lattice table is missing. Not used when rbmk_lattice.json is present.

xsec.doppler_feedback_scale.source: Hand-set scale used only by the legacy fallback cell. Not used when the derived lattice table is present.

lattice.library.source: Currently ENDF/B-VIII.0 via the openmc-data-storage JSON mirror. AGREED TARGET: ROSFOND / ABBN-RF (NIKIET lineage). Swap via tools/lattice --source rosfond.
